fields.description: Contra ledger used when the statement line is a DEBIT for this company (reduces balance with broker). This account is debited; the demat ledger account is credited.

fields.description: Contra ledger used when the statement line is a CREDIT for this company (increases balance with broker). This account is credited; the demat ledger account is debited.
